input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fuzz.dp.cpp. The migrated file had dpct helpers, DPCT_* macros and dpct/dpct.hpp includes; I replaced them with a plain sycl::queue (enable_profiling), sycl::malloc_device/memcpy/free, a 1-D parallel_for over sycl::range<1>(n) computing norm * sycl::tanh(drive * in[i]), and event profiling for the kernel_ms print. The norm is computed on the host exactly as in the CUDA source. The file compiles with icpx -fsycl with 0 warnings and add_dpct_include=false (no dpct headers needed). Not verified: I have no run/verify tool, so I did not execute the binary or check the -96 dBFS null against the C++ reference. Numerical equivalence is expected (same float tanh and multiply, no fast-math) but unproven.
